title: Clearing a pivot variable
statement: Let $V$ be a finite set, choose a variable $p\in V$, and let $P$ and $R$ be linear equations over $ rr/2 rr$ on $V$. The result of clearing the pivot from $R$ is $R$ itself if its coefficient at $p$ is zero, and otherwise is the sum $R+P$.
hypotheses_covered: A pivot variable in the variable set
